setup.wizardSubtitle: This is what your nanny sees on shifts, hours, and pay. You can change it later in settings.

children.wizardSubtitle: Add each child and the regular hours they'll need your nanny. You can add extra sessions any time.
children.manageSubtitle: Add or edit children and the regular hours they need your nanny. Extra sessions can be added any time.
children.emptyDescription: Add your first child to get started.

invite.wizardSubtitle: Share this code — they'll enter it when they sign up.
invite.manageSubtitle: Generate an invite code to add a nanny, co-parent, or helper.
invite.joinSubtitle: Enter the invite code the family sent you.
invite.shareMessage: Join our household on Steadily Nanny — use invite code {{code}} when you sign in.

nanny.title: Nanny
nanny.description: Can clock in, view their shifts, and submit hours.

parent.title: Co-parent
parent.description: Can view the schedule and approve hours — joins your existing household.

helper.title: Helper
helper.description: Can view the schedule and hours — read-only, no editing.

offer.draftState: Draft offer · nobody has seen this yet
offer.editReplacesCode: Changing this replaces the invite code — you'll need to share the new one.

absorb.title: Add {{name}} to your family?
absorb.body: {{name}} has proposed terms — you'll review them next. They join {{household}} once you agree, and they can't see your family's schedule or details until then. Nothing changes for anyone already in your family.

decision.title: You're already set up with {{existingName}}
decision.bodyCarer: {{nannyName}} is in it, and her schedule, hours and pay history live there. Joining another family would close this one.
decision.bodyNoCarer: Joining {{otherName}} would close {{existingName}}. Nothing is deleted — you just won't be able to add to it any more.
decision.wallLine: To join another family, you'd need to remove {{nannyName}} from {{existingName}} first. Her hours stay on the record either way.
decision.shareMessage: Join our family on Steadily. Code: {{code}}. It keeps {{nannyName}}'s schedule, hours and pay in one place for both of us.

availability.wizardSubtitle: Select the days you can work, then set your usual hours for each.
availability.manageSubtitle: Update the days and hours you're available to work.

householdSettings.manageSubtitle: Update your household's name, time zone, address, and who may make changes.
householdSettings.notAvailableDescription: Household settings are managed by a parent on this household.
householdSettings.timezoneWarning: Changing the time zone only affects new schedules and how "this week" is calculated going forward. Shifts and hours you've already recorded keep the time zone they were created in and won't change.
householdSettings.timezoneConfirmBody: This only affects new schedules and how "this week" is calculated going forward. Shifts and hours you've already recorded keep the time zone they were created in and will not change.
householdSettings.weekStartHint: This defines your household's pay week — every carer's hours are totaled against it.
householdSettings.weekStartLockedHint: Locked because hours have been recorded — it defines pay weeks.
householdSettings.removeMemberConfirmBody: They'll lose access to this household right away. You can invite them again later if you change your mind.
householdSettings.leaveHint: Only a parent in this household can add you back.
householdSettings.leaveConfirmBody: You'll lose access to this household's schedule, hours and pay. The hours you've already worked stay on their record, and a parent would have to invite you back.
householdSettings.leaveOwnerError: You created this household, so you can't leave it — someone has to be able to manage it.
householdSettings.leaveClockedInError: You're clocked in. Clock out first, then leave.

closures.notAvailableDescription: Closures are managed by a parent on this household.
closures.screenSubtitle: Let the household know when no cover is needed — carers can see these dates.
closures.deleteConfirmDescription: Days it covered will count as needing cover again.
closures.emptyDescription: Dates you add will appear here.

careHours.sectionBody: Share the regular hours {{childName}} needs your nanny each week. We'll let you know if any of them aren't scheduled or confirmed yet. You can add extra sessions any time.
careHours.emptyBody: Without these hours, we can't tell you when something isn't booked or confirmed yet.

form.intro: These are the recurring hours you need your nanny each week. We'll tell you when any of them aren't scheduled or confirmed yet.
form.labelHelper: Your nanny sees this on her schedule, so she knows the shape of the day is deliberate.
